sentences.text: Along with the rejoinder-affidavit, in respect of the Cemetery proposed next to Deonar Colony, a site plan and a chart disclosing certain information have been enclosed.
According to the said documents, the total land reserved for Cemetery is 9800 sq.mtrs., out of which over an area of 6822.46 sq.mtrs., Slum Rehabilitation Scheme has been proposed.

The said chart further discloses that construction of the Slum Rehabilitation Scheme is to come up over an area of 4557.72 sq.mtrs.
and rest of 2264.74 sq.mtrs. area is to be kept as open area.
It is this 2264.74 sq.mtrs. area which is proposed to be reserved now for Cemetery.

3. As per the chart, if the area of the proposed Slum Rehabilitation Scheme and the Cemetery is excluded from the total area of plot of 9800 sq.mtrs., 2977.54 sq.mtr. area is still left, where temporary Municipal Transit Camp is located, however, as per the learned counsel for the petitioners, the occupants of the said transit camp have vacated the same.

4. When the matter is next listed, learned counsel representing the Municipal Corporation and the SRA shall inform the Court about the factual correctness of the information contained in chart and the sketch map appended to the rejoinder-affidavit filed by the petitioners.

We also require the Municipal Corporation and the SRA to consider as to whether 2977.54 sq.mtrs. area where the Municipal Transit Camp exists can be proposed for Cemetery along with the area of 2264.74 sq.mtrs.
5.

In respect of the Cemetery at Rafi Nagar, we have already observed in our earlier order that the venue identified for Cemetery is not feasible for the reason that there is a solid 904-PIL-35-2023 +
waste heap.

In pursuance of our earlier orders, it has been informed by the learned counsel appearing for the Municipal Corporation that some other plot in the vicinity of 3 km. has been identified and feasibility study is being undertaken and, in that process, a medical team of the Municipal Corporation has already paid a visit to the said plot.

6. When the matter is next listed, the learned counsel for the Municipal Corporation shall inform the Court as to minimum time in which the feasibility study can be completed so that appropriate action may be taken for proposing the change of reservation of the plot for being used as Cemetery.

7. As far as the plot abutting Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited is concerned, the learned Advocate General informs the Court that the endeavour made by the State authorities for acquiring the said land through private negotiations did not succeed and accordingly the process of compulsory acquisition under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act of 2013")

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: has been initiated and in this regard proposal has already been sent by the Municipal Corporation to acquire the plot.
The learned Advocate General further informs that the Municipal Corporation has been required to deposit 30% of the amount of compensation which may be paid in case the acquisition takes place.
He also informs that the Sub Division Officer of the area concerned has already been appointed as Acquisition Officer.
We, thus, expect that the Municipal Corporation shall take appropriate steps to deposit the 30% of compensation amount.

Thus, having noticed that the process of compulsory acquisition has already been initiated, we direct that all the statutory procedures for acquisition shall be completed within minimum statutory period in terms of the provisions of the Act of 2013, however, if, in the meantime, any process of private negotiations succeeds, the same can also be taken recourse to by the State and the Municipal Corporation.
9. Stand over to 10th November, 2023.
To be listed High on Board.

(ARIF S. DOCTOR, J.) (CHIEF JUSTICE)
